scenes.brief: A broad river bends past a gravel bank. Three tall trees stand on the far bank, with a low hill behind them under a pale overcast sky.
A small pond lies between reeds and a grassy slope. A wooden landing extends from the left bank, with scattered clouds reflected on the water.
A narrow canal passes beneath a low stone bridge. Garden walls line one side and leafy trees line the other in soft afternoon light.
A quiet inlet meets a flat sandy shore. Two small boats rest near the water and distant headlands sit beneath a light grey sky.
A village street curves past modest stone houses. A low wall and a single tree occupy the foreground, with hills visible beyond the roofs.
A country house stands beside an orchard. A gravel path crosses the foreground and a small shed stands on the right under a clear morning sky.
A square stone tower rises behind a cluster of low tiled roofs. An open field fills the foreground, with a few shrubs along a narrow footpath.
A courtyard is enclosed by two simple farm buildings. A gate opens toward distant fields and a patch of sunlight falls across the bare ground.
An open meadow slopes gently toward distant wooded hills. A narrow path crosses the grass and a few irregular clouds fill the upper sky.
A rocky hillside carries scattered pine trees. A broad valley extends behind the foreground rocks, with distant mountains in hazy daylight.
Rows of fruit trees stretch across a gently rising field. Tall grass borders the nearest row and a dark wood lies at the horizon.
A river passes a small village at the foot of a hill. A stone wall crosses the foreground, with open grass and two trees beside the water.
A farmhouse stands above a shallow stream. A footbridge connects two grassy banks and an orchard spreads behind the house in diffuse daylight.
A lakeside path passes a low stone building and a cluster of trees. Water occupies the left half and a gentle ridge crosses the background.
